snippet.title: Kitty Powers' Matchmaker Makeover Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
COMING SOON!

Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307120/Kitty_Powers_Matchmaker_Makeover

Celebrate 10 years of matchmaking in this remastered version of the viral sensation Kitty Powers' Matchmaker!

In Kitty Powers’ Matchmaker Makeover, players step back into the role of a matchmaking agency manager, helping quirky clients find their true love under the expert guidance of the fabulous Kitty Powers. 

This remastered version comes bursting with vibrant new artwork, expanded customization options, and a host of gameplay improvements to make matchmaking even more fun and inclusive.

Releasing in 2025 on Steam, Apple App Store and Google Play.

Visit magicnotion.com for more! https://magicnotion.com/matchmaker-makeover
